protocol.criterion: Each candidate versus diverse: mean>=1percentage point; Bonferroni2 percentile bootstrap lower>0; positive leave-one-out means;8+ deterioration<=0.2percentage point
protocol.uncertainty: 10,000 bootstrap resamples of whole32seed replicates; approximate exploratory intervals; prior adaptive search is not erased
protocol.historical: Dataset is provenance context only. No historical outcomes or current reserved scenarios evaluated; uniform84/20/10 assumed
protocol.stoppingRule: No extending budget, retuning parameters or changing metric after results. If neither qualifies, stop these configurations; if one qualifies, preregister independent confirmation
protocol.activation: None. Qualifying is not deployment or permission to consume existing holdout
